title: Vellai Pookal
desc: A 57-year-old retired officer in the Chennai crime branch goes to Seattle to reunite with his estranged son. However, a missing case in his son's neighbourhood prompts him to start an investigation.

title: Dharala Prabhu
desc: Prabhu's life turns upside down when Dr Kannadasan, the owner of a fertility clinic, approaches him to become a sperm donor.

title: Kannum Kannum Kollaiyadithaal
desc: Siddharth and Kalli never seem to be short on money. However, when they meet the women of their dreams, they are pushed into reconsidering their career choices.

desc: Biju Poulose leaves his teaching job to pursue his dream of serving in the police force. Posted as the sub-inspector in Cochin, he has to handle notorious criminals who indulge in unlawful activities.

title: Thug Life
desc: Adopted by a gang leader, Amaran faces suspicion after an assassination attempt.

desc: Max, a military dog, returns to the United States after a traumatic experience in Afghanistan. However, his handler's family adopt him and strive to help him recover.

title: Pokkiri Paiyan
desc: After walking away from a Hong Kong crime boss, a man sets up his own gang. Later, he is tempted by an offer to execute his former employer.

desc: A humble textile worker meets a staunch Communist after a tragic incident. Subsequently, he joins the movement after enduring exploitation, sparking a fight for workers' rights.

title: Mudinja Vazhu
desc: Seven young contestants take part in a reality TV show. They spend a week inside a haunted house and soon witness paranormal activities around them.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: OK Kanmani
desc: Adi and Tara meet during a wedding ceremony and fall in love. However, they decide to start a live-in relationship as they do not believe in the institution of marriage.

title: Nimir
desc: Selvam, a photographer, lives in a town with a small studio of his own. One day, when he gets assaulted, he decides to not wear his slippers until he gets revenge on the culprits.

title: Santharppavaathi
desc: Gautham, a security guard, comes across his grandfather's diary that takes him on a treasure hunt. Meanwhile, Sultan, a terrorist, holds a Pakistani archaeologist hostage to find a treasure.

title: Meiyazhagan

title: Asuran

title: Aruvam
